:::{#rem-cv-se}
#### The fold-based standard error is only a rough guide

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1] draw standard-error bars
computed from the per-fold errors as in @eq-cv-se.
That formula treats the $\nfolds$ fold errors
as if they were independent,
which they are not:
every pair of folds shares $\nfolds - 2$ folds of training data.
So $\cvse{\nfolds}$ is a rough indication
of how much $\cvest{\nfolds}$ might change with a different sample,
not a [standard error](estimation.qmd#def-SE) of $\cvest{\nfolds}$.

:::
